text:
Anya: Quick async check — putting together sprint handoff doc for the dedicated capacity buildout. Need owners on a few items and ETA for arrivals. Can folks ping status below?

Mike: I can own GPU arrivals (tracking with vendor). ETA: last confirmed ETA for wave 1 is 3/28, vendor said on-time but awaiting ASN. Will update when we get ASN.

Oliver: Rack sequencing and power are with infra team — tagging @Tariq for final sequencing dates.

Tariq: I can take rack sequencing. We need final rack IDs from procurement (they changed some SKUs). Blocker: PSU adapters delay; asking vendor for expedited ship. If we get adapters by 3/26, we can schedule install 3/29.

Jess: Canary slots + staging smoke testing — I own canary plan. Need capacity reservation numbers from Mike (how many nodes for canary?).

Mike: For canary let's reserve 2 nodes (8 GPUs) for rolling canary plus 1 spare. Pls reserve 3 nodes on staging cluster C.

Anya: thx. @infra-bot do we have reservation command for that? paste CLI?

infra-bot: To reserve nodes run:
```bash
redwood-cli reserve --cluster staging-c --nodes 3 --reason "canary rollout"
```

Oliver: I'm waiting on power quote — target to finish by EOD tomorrow; otherwise fallback is to shift canary to another rack.

Tariq: FYI SRE has requested canary alerting hooks — @sre-oncall can you confirm?

sre-oncall: I'll add the alerting runbook and slack hooks. ETA today afternoon. Also need the canary prompt set and eval baseline from Jess.

Jess: Will drop prompt set in /sprints/canary/prompts and link to evals: https://internal.redwood/evals/382

Mike: Shipping update: ASN inbound, expected at our DC 3/27 morning. I'll post tracking once ASN received. If adapters delay persists we still can stage nodes but not power them.

Anya: Ok next steps: Mike updates ASN + opens reservation (if adapter arrives we schedule rack install), Tariq finalizes rack sequence and PSU fallback, Jess preps prompts and smoke tests, SRE adds alerts. I'll assemble a short milestone table and share by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

Anya: quick ping — @Oliver can you review the PR that wires rack labels to inventory? https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412

Oliver: On it, aiming to review this afternoon.
